title: plugin-security: the AI-account ceiling refusal judges served holders only, so a disabled package's breaching set can be granted to an AI account
body:
domain:server#2 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CaP1iy4RSEQbW6177G

立卡门 ① · 已落地工作欠的后续：#32164 P2（PR #32306）专题红线复读 6817314015 的 should-note S2。Part of #31527 (ADR-0150)。Blocked-by #32306.

## What

The AI-account ceiling refusal (`packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/agent-account-grant-refusal.ts`, `setBreaches`, its fail-closed arm near :245-250 at PR #32306's head) judges the permission-set definitions of **served** holders only. A disabled package is not served, so a stored grant of a disabled package's set whose permissions breach the ceiling can be moved onto an AI service account and is admitted. `main` answers the same for one holder, so #32306 loosens nothing, and the clamp at evaluation still holds; the door refusal is what is missing.

## Acceptance

- The ceiling judges the grant's own holder's definition whether or not that holder is enabled (or refuses fail-closed when the definition cannot be read).
- Pins: a disabled package's breaching set granted to an AI account is refused; an enabled holder's non-breaching set is admitted as today (CONTROL).
- `Clause-②:` measured (a 201 moves to a 400: `no (narrowing)` expected).

## 业务理由

谁受益：给 AI 服务账号授权的管理员与安全审计。场景：某包停用后，其超出 AI 上限的权限集授权被转给 AI 账号。不做：授权门不拒，只靠运行时裁剪兜底，审计看到一条本应被拒的授权。

## 读者

`domain:server` 席位（专题 #31527 派），#32306 合并后；起点 `agent-account-grant-refusal.ts` 的 `setBreaches`。

## 查重
